Class GraphStore

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.lcarsgraph.GraphStore
public final class GraphStore extends Object
One canvas owns one graph. The store writes the rows the model holds and reads them back on the same connection.

  • Method Details

    • save

      public void save(GraphModel model, String canvasId) throws SQLException
      The method writes one canvas and removes a row the model dropped. A length fault is thrown before any delete. A failed commit rolls the write back and reloads the last committed rows.
      Parameters:
      model - The model that holds the graph.
      canvasId - The canvas that owns the rows.
      Throws:
      SQLException - The exception is a JDBC failure.

    • load

      public void load(GraphModel model, String canvasId) throws SQLException
      The method reads one canvas into the model. A canvas with no rows leaves the model empty. Node names are read in name order.
      Parameters:
      model - The model that receives the rows.
      canvasId - The canvas that owns the rows.
      Throws:
      SQLException - The exception is a JDBC failure.

    • capture

      GraphStore.Shot capture(String canvasId) throws SQLException
      The method reads one canvas into a snapshot. The snapshot is the rows the model thread pours. The connection stays on the caller.
      Parameters:
      canvasId - The canvas that owns the rows.
      Returns:
      The return value is that snapshot.
      Throws:
      SQLException - The exception is a JDBC failure.

    • snap

      static GraphStore.Shot snap(GraphModel model)
      The method copies one model into a snapshot. The copy is the rows a later save writes. The caller keeps the model.
      Parameters:
      model - The model that holds the graph.
      Returns:
      The return value is that snapshot.

    • saveShot

      void saveShot(GraphStore.Shot shot, String canvasId) throws SQLException
      The method writes one snapshot. The live model stays unread. A failed commit reloads the copy, not the live model.
      Parameters:
      shot - The snapshot the model thread handed over.
      canvasId - The canvas that owns the rows.
      Throws:
      SQLException - The exception is a JDBC failure.

    • pour

      static void pour(GraphModel model, GraphStore.Shot shot)
      The method fills one model from a snapshot. A null snapshot leaves the model empty.
      Parameters:
      model - The model that receives the rows.
      shot - The snapshot the vault thread read.
